messages:
tara: Heads-up — velora14b (int4) onboarding run hit intermittent OOMs and a latency tail this morning on the long-context bench. rolling canary back.
owen: can you drop the error snippet?
tara: snippet:
```
2026-03-24T07:45:02Z WARN  kv_cache: slots_allocated=384 -> 412 (+28)
2026-03-24T07:45:02Z ERROR oom: alloc fail attention_kv size=987654321
2026-03-24T07:45:02Z INFO  request id=zz gen_tokens=1500 route=velora14b-int4
```
li: 1500 tokens + prefetch=2 + batch=3 on int4 will churn slots. int4 helps bandwidth but the slot-count math bites us.
mike: initial bench numbers?
tara: p50=180ms (ok), p95=980ms (higher than fp16 baseline 520ms). throughput down ~25% during the long-gen synthetic traffic. quality (QA F1) looks within 0.3% of fp16 overall but a few long-context prompts show increased token-mismatch.
owen: two buckets of fixes: conservative defaults for safe rollout, and an experimental perf-tuning branch. propose conservative defaults first.
li: conservative suggestion:
- max_new_tokens: 512
- prefetch_window: 1
- batch_size: 2
- soft_evict: true (kv_trim admin)
- compactor_interval_s: 300
mike: also add route-level fallback: if requested max_new_tokens > 1024, route to velora14b-int8. reduces risk of OOMs for heavy requests.
tara: i'll push a small route patch and run a 45m smoke with 200 randomized long-gen replays + 100 evals. threshold: no OOMs, p95 within 20% of fp16, quality delta <0.5% on eval set.
infra-bot: deploybot: canary patch queued by tara 527 job #4011. will run smoke and post artifacts.
li: diagnostics to collect during smoke: nvml-smi snapshots every 30s, jemalloc stats, slot-usage histogram, and kernel memmap. add `--nvml-snap --jemalloc-stats --slot-hist` flags to smoke-runner.
owen: if smoke passes, ramp plan: 5% traffic for 2h with slowstart (0.5x increase every 20m) and compactor_interval=180s. capture nvml diffs and snapshot at each step.
mike: perf-tuning branch idea (for later): adaptive_prefetch that reduces prefetch when free_slots_ratio < 0.25, and microbatch packing that limits high-token requests per batch. might keep batch_size=4 for short-gen but split long-gen.
li: microbatching rule: if gen_tokens_requested >= 512, force batch_size <=2 for that request. simple router predicate.
tara: noted. also saw small quality regression in a rare prompt group: token-levenshtein increased for story prompts with nested code. sara (not here) flagged it in eval. we should include those in the smoke eval set.
owen: agreed. add targeted prompts of that pattern (20 cases) to smoke eval. rollback if any >2% token-mismatch.
infra-bot: deploybot: smoke run #4011 started, will publish logs to /artifacts/velora14b/4011.tar.gz when complete.
mike: after smoke, if we still see OOMs, fallback plan: enable per-pod kv_max_slots cap, and serve int8 for any request where requested tokens > 800. also consider increasing compactor duty cycle temporarily.
li: long-term: we should add an onboarding checklist item: for int4 models, require long-context bench, slot-hist capture, and conservative defaults before any public rollout.
tara: i'll file a short PR with the route patch + smoke runner flags and link here. aiming to re-run today and report results. thanks all. :thumbsup:
